direction_judgment.reason: Source supports a substantive system of leader/context selection, base/support and confirmation, tight pre-entry risk, repeated attempts and right-tail holding. Full continuous account contrasts can distinguish entry cost, reentry friction, context and exits. Six named seen controls can inform these mechanisms, while population strategy profitability remains a separate eventual claim.

source_fidelity_limits: Daily, hourly and weekly context all occur in actual passages; hourly EMA9/21 and 1/5minute trigger examples cannot silently become only daily EMAs.
Long trend/strength exits are supported; exact15% at3R is an explicit local long adaptation, not proved faithful long exit just because the separate short essay uses it.
Source anchor hindsight adjustment motivates a prospective surrogate but does not prove that surrogate has edge. Closed-loop negative trades and rejected/missed opportunities must remain.

required_scientific_corrections.title: Freeze the actual context-to-Frame and setup-epoch contract
required_scientific_corrections.evidence: geometry.context emits daily EMA/strength/return30, while DecisionSystem consumes externally supplied leadership, market, first_retest, supports, epoch, sessions_since_risk_pause. The plan names index/own-feedback/context concepts but does not define these producers.
required_scientific_corrections.consequence: A consumer could change which opportunities exist, reset attempt budgets, or create/avoid a permanent pause while all8 candidate IDs remain unchanged. This prevents falsifiable full-system contrasts.
required_scientific_corrections.required: Add one executable definition table/formulas for each external decision field: price basis and daily/hourly/weekly role, finite warmup, trailing leadership/liquidity eligibility and tie-breaking, QQQ/IWM regime rules and missing-data behavior, known support levels, first-retest counting, causal setup-ID creation/freeze/invalidation, touch expiry across sessions, and pause-entry/recovery clock. Freeze which components are source-supported versus local adaptations. Do not require PIT broad-universe perfection for the conditional six-name study. Consumer implementation may follow, but may not supply these scientific definitions ad hoc.

required_scientific_corrections.title: Make the matched policy/order contrasts unambiguous
required_scientific_corrections.evidence: Plan declares8policies x2executionroutes, while prototype Intent.price_cap exists only for P_SYSTEM; P_SYSTEM simultaneously changes anchor ranking. Campaign describes B_BREAK base/ORH and P_EMA rising EMA, whereas code uses base-level only and does not test rising in the policy. B_BREAK blueprint says full common holding but full_path only applies P_HOLD/P_FEEDBACK/P_SYSTEM.
required_scientific_corrections.consequence: Cost-cap benefits and anchor/context/holding effects would be confounded or a stated cell would not exist.
required_scientific_corrections.required: Freeze the exact8-row component matrix plus independent2-route definition. Prefer applying market/capped route at the same decision and common policy-specific book for every policy; freeze cap, expiry, latency, partial/nonfill and attribution assumptions. If a bundle is intentional, label the bundle and remove isolated-lift claims. Resolve B_BREAK base-versus-ORH, rising EMA and common-versus-added holding wording/code without adding hidden variants; keep96 ceiling, continuous two-year book and disclosed yearly slices. Exact per-cell IDs/identities required before any run.

required_scientific_corrections.title: Freeze ordered event and continuous cash/feedback semantics
required_scientific_corrections.evidence: Prototype eligible_after=end+1microsecond conflicts with an unqualified next-bar-open whose timestamp can equal end. Plan/spec also say next observed price for daily exits, but active missing-minute paths are supposed to be unknown. Book is externally supplied; fee20 sizing is hardcoded across20/40 stress, reservations/settlement and terminal action handling are not yet fixed.
required_scientific_corrections.consequence: Consumer choices can add a minute delay, skip adverse gaps, overcommit simultaneous cash, or change feedback/holding economics.
required_scientific_corrections.required: Define close/intent/next eligible scheduled-price ordering, 1/5/15 grids including stubs, entry/standing-stop/trim/daily-exit precedence, adverse opening gaps and withinbar conditional path scenarios (not universal NAV bounds), missing-active-path propagation, pending cancellation and exact reentry epoch behavior. Specify20k joint book, simultaneous symbol priority, pre-fill cash/risk reservations at cap plus actual cost scenario, settled versus sale-credit assumption, exdate receivable/payable cash/action shares and unknown rights, mark clock, closed-lot fee-inclusive R and monthly/reset/pause rules. No afterfill size repair or zero-filling unknown NAV. These can be declared research proxies with honest limitations; no broker-grade proof is required merely to study legal price components.

prototype_findings_before_consumer_accep.fact: Independent inert report: trim intent71 on476 held shares accepted an exit_report quantity476 and closed all. A stopout dated a day before the actual entry also passed.
prototype_findings_before_consumer_accep.fix: Validate order/report identity, remaining order quantity and monotonic event times. Bound trim fills by the intent outstanding quantity; protective fills cannot predate actual held state. Include stop/trim cancellation or OCO consistency.

prototype_findings_before_consumer_accep.fact: A one-share entry_report for a476-share submitted order clears pending without recording remaining order fate.
prototype_findings_before_consumer_accep.fix: Either implement cumulative partial reports and terminal/cancel acknowledgment, or explicitly choose a conditional full-fill-or-terminal-partial model with documented cancellation and reservations. No dangling live remainder or extra protective quantity.

prototype_findings_before_consumer_accep.fact: Missing active data only logs and returns; policy state itself is not permanently unknown. touch_end can carry across sessions/epoch choices, and first_retest externally controls retry eligibility.
prototype_findings_before_consumer_accep.fix: Bind consumer sticky unknown NAV/path behavior and frozen touch/epoch/retry producers; later valid bars cannot silently heal an unidentified active interval. Tests must cover overnight actions, pending/held gaps, multiple simultaneous intents and pause restart.
